children: Stewart Information Services' board has raised the real-estate services company's quarterly dividend by 4.8%, to 55 cents from 52.5 cents.
The new payout, equal to $2.20 a year, represents an annual yield of about 3.15% based on Friday's closing price of $69.91, up from 3%.
The Houston company on Monday said the increased dividend is payable Sept. 30 to shareholders of record Sept. 15.
